reference.description: Actual Melee Options screenshot. The small silver equipment illustration on the right was the explicit visual reference. Final user direction: flat colors, front facing graphics.

monitors.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. The supplied image is the ACTUAL ORIGINAL Super Smash Bros. Melee Options screen and is the explicit authoritative UI reference. Create a flat-color 2D raster icon for its aspect-ratio submenu. Match the small schematic silver equipment illustration on the RIGHT of the reference, adapted into simpler filled-color artwork. STRICT FRONT ELEVATION: exact orthographic front-facing symmetrical rectangle, all horizontals perfectly horizontal, all verticals perfectly vertical, no perspective, no visible top, side, thickness, rear, or angled edges. FLAT COLORS ONLY: one muted silver-gray body fill, one charcoal/navy screen fill, ivory thin outlines, one restrained muted gold accent. No gradients, no gloss, no metallic material rendering, no glass reflection, no 3D, no realistic texture, no drop shadows, no glow. An economical Melee menu hardware graphic, clear at 160px wide, restrained early-2000s game UI illustration. Transparent alpha background, centered full object and base visible, generous empty transparent margins, no surrounding panel or decoration, no lettering, no numbers, no labels, no logo, no watermark. Subject: 4:3 standard monitor. Its dark screen opening must be a geometrically exact 4:3 rectangle, straight-on. Modestly thick silver-gray bezel with slightly rounded corners, tiny symmetrical vent dots below the screen, one small muted-gold power indicator, short centered rectangular foot. Keep the illustrated silhouette compact and slightly taller than the widescreen counterpart. Render as crisp flat graphic, like a simple screen-printed pictogram with filled interior. Square output.

widescreen_correction: Edit this flat front-facing monitor asset. Keep its colors, clean ivory outline, flat gray bezel, navy screen, centered gold power button and simple foot. Correct the geometry: its visible dark SCREEN is currently too wide and too short. Make the dark screen opening EXACTLY 16:9, not ultrawide. For example the dark opening should occupy x=170..1070 and y=290..796 on a 1240-square canvas: width 900, height 506. Increase screen height substantially while preserving its width. The silver bezel and body must grow vertically around that corrected screen. The final overall monitor body excluding stand should have width-to-height near 1.6, with the inner dark screen exactly 1.7778. Strict symmetrical front view, no perspective, no visible side/top, no texture, no glossy lighting, no gradient, no shadows. Flat limited colors only. Transparent alpha background with full monitor and stand safely in frame. No text, no labels, no numbers. Preserve the Melee UI palette and simple 2D graphic style.

netplay_concepts.prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Redesign the actual Melee room-browser screenshot into a polished NETPLAY ROOM BROWSER concept. Preserve Melee's navy warped grid, translucent diagonal green ribbons, ghosted Smash emblem, thin beveled red-orange angular VS Mode frame, italic condensed header, yellow-gold focus fill and black heavy italic labels. A 4:3 game screen, not a website. Header Netplay / Room Browser; room table columns Room, Players, Rules, Ping; selected row Friendly Melee with 1 / 2, 4 stock · 8 min, 32 ms. Other sample rows Final Destination and Late Night Sets. Selected-room detail panel with Items Off, Rollback, Open. Bottom controller actions A Join Room, X Create Room, Y Refresh, B Back. Help bar Choose a room to join. Remove unrelated VS sidebar. No real hostnames or IP addresses.

Use case: ui-mockup. Redesign the actual Melee lobby screenshot into a polished NETPLAY LOBBY concept. Preserve Melee's navy warped grid, translucent green ribbons, ghosted Smash emblem, red-orange angular VS Mode frame, italic condensed header, gold focus with black heavy italic labels. A 4:3 game screen. Header Netplay / Friendly Melee. Two player panels: red P1 Host and blue P2 Guest with silver GameCube controller illustrations and READY status. Shared rules strip 4 STOCK, 8 MIN, ITEMS OFF, 2F DELAY. Connection 32 ms / Rollback. Gold Start Match action, Change Rules, Leave Room. Controller legend A Confirm, X Ready, B Back. Help bar Both players are ready. The host can start. No real hostnames or IP addresses.

notes: Concept sample data is illustrative. Implemented UI must use live room/player state. Final monitor PNGs preserve generated alpha; runtime drawing fits their screen openings to the labeled aspect ratio.
